name: Chibi Style
tagline: Create chibi-style avatars, emotes and stickers from photos or text
description: Chibi Style is an independently operated web tool for generating chibi-style images from a photo or written idea. It is aimed at creators and streamers making avatars, Twitch emotes and Discord stickers. Users choose a mood and generate up to four PNG images. The website offers starter credits, one-time credit packs from $4.99 and a $19.99 monthly plan. Paid options unlock watermark-free HD output and commercial usage rights, subject to the service terms. It is not an official partner of the gaming or community platforms mentioned. Users should upload only photos they have permission to use and check each output before publication.
